high_level_description: The courtyard of the Blue House in Coyoacán, Mexico City, where Frida Kahlo lived: cobalt-blue walls with red trim, tropical plants, and a small stepped pyramid with clay figures.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A bright sky above intensely cobalt-blue walls.

elements.desc: Intense cobalt-blue walls with red-brown window frames and green shutters.
A small stepped pyramid in the garden with pre-Hispanic clay figures on its steps.
Big tropical plants, cacti and a palm.
Pots of red geraniums along a path.
